name: smwgraphics-basic-small-text
title: Basic Small Text
description:
A general purpose small 8x8 font for use as in-level text (labels, cutscenes, credits, etc.) that uses vanilla palettes. It includes the usual alphanumeric characters, common punctuation and a handful of basic symbols.

I've included 2BPP versions of the font for use on Layer 3 and in Message Boxes as ExGraphics as well as a replacement for the default Layer 3 font (GFX2A).
